continuous_features.name: close
continuous_features.context: The final trading price at the end of the day. This is the primary price metric and often used as the target for prediction models.

continuous_features.name: open
continuous_features.context: The first trading price at the start of the day. Useful for calculating daily range and gap analysis.

continuous_features.name: high
continuous_features.description: Bitcoin highest price in USD during the day.
continuous_features.context: The maximum price reached during the trading day. Used to calculate volatility and trading ranges.

continuous_features.name: low
continuous_features.description: Bitcoin lowest price in USD during the day.
continuous_features.context: The minimum price reached during the trading day. Used to calculate volatility and trading ranges.

continuous_features.name: volume
continuous_features.context: The total amount of Bitcoin traded during the day. May include notation like 'K' (thousands), 'M' (millions), or 'B' (billions). High volume often indicates strong conviction in price movements.

continuous_features.name: fng_value
continuous_features.context: Ranges from 0 to 100, where 0-24 indicates 'Extreme Fear', 25-49 'Fear', 50 'Neutral', 51-75 'Greed', and 76-100 'Extreme Greed'. This sentiment indicator reflects market psychology and can be a contrarian signal.

continuous_features.name: change_percent
continuous_features.description: Daily percentage change in Bitcoin price.
continuous_features.context: Represents the percentage move of the price for the current day. This indicates the daily momentum and volatility leading up to the prediction target.

categorical_features.name: fng_classification
categorical_features.context: Text labels: 'Extreme Fear', 'Fear', 'Neutral', 'Greed', 'Extreme Greed'. Categorical representation of the fng_value metric.

temporal_features.name: date
temporal_features.context: Daily granularity. Can be used to extract cyclical features like day of week, month, quarter, or year. Bitcoin markets operate 24/7 unlike traditional markets.
temporal_features.note: Consider extracting: day_of_week (cyclical), month (cyclical), year, days_since_halving, or proximity to major crypto events.
